verdict.rationale: Runpod docs say Pods can be reached through a web proxy for exposed web services, which covers serving applications from an instance. Instant Clusters offer managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking, which implies inter-node connectivity but is not described as user-configurable private networking between instances. Community comments that the execution environment is 'locked down' hint at connectivity limits but do not concretely contradict port exposure. Missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring exposed HTTP/TCP ports, documented private networking between standalone Pods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
